# Violations IQ

> Violations IQ is an AI-assisted, human-reviewed service that converts HOA governing documents into standardized violation catalogs prepared for CINC.

## Primary page

- https://violationsiq-beta.sliceo.co/ — Product overview, workflow, common questions, and closed-beta access request.

## Product summary

- Intended for community association management teams using CINC.
- Processes HOA CC&Rs, bylaws, and fine schedules.
- Links proposed catalog entries to source evidence.
- Requires human review and approval before delivery to CINC.

## Publisher

- Sliceo: https://www.sliceo.co/
